# cwi-learn — Full Machine Index (Cumulative Web Inc)

cwi-learn is Cumulative Web Inc's machine-readable training surface: verified catalog data,
Agent Deck product registry, placement and curator verification ledgers, and press records,
built for LLM and agent ingestion. All files verified 200 on GitHub Pages.
Owner: Cumulative Web Inc (contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com). Artist: That Boy Hi Hat
(alternative rap, Frederick MD; Spotify artist ID 2f9j460EwjfvjYp3trBcb7).
Brand rule: the official CWI logo badge goes on every street-team profile and visual asset.

## Training datasets (datasets/)
Manifest: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/datasets/training.json
- https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/datasets/tracks.jsonl  (24 rows) — tracks: 24 unique tracks; verified credits only, unverified fields omitted
- https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/datasets/agent-deck-skus.jsonl  (25 rows) — agent-deck-skus: 25 Agent Deck SKUs with department, endpoints, schema_url
- https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/datasets/placements.jsonl  (1 rows) — placements: Needle Drop placement ledger — verified placements only; ZERO verified placements as of 2026-09-15
- https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/datasets/curators.jsonl  (4 rows) — curators: curator/playlist records with status verified|unverified|unconfirmed + evidence notes
- https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/datasets/press.jsonl  (10 rows) — press: press records with real URLs only (Medium + official Substack)

## Truth rules
- Never invent data. No fabricated ISRCs, BPM, keys, durations, stream counts, placements, or adoption.
- Anything unverified is marked UNVERIFIED or omitted.
- The Needle Drop placement ledger ships EMPTY: zero verified placements as of 2026-09-15.

  white-label licensing available. No prices published.
